entries.title: I Corinthians 16:1
segments: With reference to the Collection for Christ's People, I want you to follow the instructions that I gave to the Churches in Galatia.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:2
segments: On the first day of every week each of you should put by what he can afford, so that no collections need be made after I have come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:3
segments: On my arrival, I will send any persons, whom you may authorize by letter, to carry your gift to Jerusalem;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:4
segments: And, if it appears to be worth while for me to go also, they shall go with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:5
segments: I will come to you as soon as I have been through Macedonia- -for I am going through Macedonia-

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:6
segments: And I shall probably make some stay with you or, perhaps, remain for the winter, so that you may yourselves send me on my way, wherever I may be going.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:7
segments: I do not propose to pay you a visit in passing now, for I hope to stay with you for some time, if the Lord permits.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:8
segments: I intend, however, staying at Ephesus till the Festival at the close of the Harvest;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:9
segments: For a great opening for active work has presented itself, and there are many opponents.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:10
segments: If Timothy comes, take care that he has no cause for feeling anxious while he is with you. He is doing the Master's work no less than I am.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:11
segments: No one, therefore, should slight him. See him safely on his way to me, for I am expecting him with some of our Brothers.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:12
segments: As for our Brother Apollos, I have often urged him to go to you with the others. He has, however, been very unwilling to do so as yet; but he will go as soon as he finds a good opportunity.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:13
segments: Be watchful; stand firm in your faith; show yourselves men; be strong.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:14
segments: Let everything you do be done in a loving spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:15
segments: I have another request to make of you, Brothers. You remember Stephanas and his household, and that they were the first-fruits gathered in from Greece, and set themselves to serve Christ's People.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:16
segments: I want you, on your part, to show deference to such men as these, as well as to every fellow laborer and earnest worker.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:17
segments: I am glad Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus have come, for they have made up for your absence;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:18
segments: They have cheered my heart, and your hearts also. Recognize the worth of such men as these.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:19
segments: The Churches in Roman Asia send you their greetings. Aquila and Prisca and the Church that meets at their house send you many Christian greetings.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:20
segments: All our brothers send you greetings. Greet one another with a sacred kiss.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:21
segments: I, Paul, add this greeting in my own handwriting.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:22
segments: Accursed be any one who has no love for the Lord. THE LORD IS COMING.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:23
segments: May the blessing of the Lord Jesus be with you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:24
segments: My love to all of you who are in union with Christ Jesus.
